001: Haoran, did you join any clubs?
I joined the photography club. We meet every Wednesday afternoon.
That sounds interesting. Do you need a professional camera?
No, you can just use your phone. The club president teaches techniques.
Then I'd like to go check it out too. Is that okay?
Of course. I'll take you along to the next meeting.
002: Why are you back so late today?
I just finished a club meeting. We were discussing the welcome party for new students.
Is your club going to perform something?
Yeah, we're planning to sing a Chinese song together.
Then you really need to practice well.
I know. The performance is next month, so time is pretty tight.
003: Zixuan, what have you been busy with lately?
I'm preparing for the debate club's campus competition. We train every day.
Debate sounds really hard. You have to memorize a lot, right?
It's mostly about practicing logic and reaction speed. It's pretty good training.
Next Friday afternoon. If you're free, you can come watch.
004: How many clubs did you sign up for? I signed up for three.
I only joined one, the calligraphy club. I was afraid I wouldn't have enough time.
What kind of activities does the calligraphy club usually do?
We practice writing twice a week, and sometimes we invite teachers to give lectures.
That's nice. You can calm down and learn something.
Yeah, it's much better than staring at your phone all day.
005: Does your volunteer club have any activities this weekend?
Yes, we're planning to visit the elderly at a nursing home.
Do we need to prepare anything?
We're planning to bring some fruit and daily necessities.
Of course, you're welcome. We're meeting at the school gate at eight on Saturday morning.
006: I heard you became the president of the anime club. Congratulations!
Thanks, but I'm actually a little nervous. I'm afraid I won't do a good job.
What plans does your club have recently?
We want to hold a campus anime exhibition next month. We're preparing for it now.
If you need any help, just let me know.
Great, I'll definitely have to trouble you then.
007: Did you join the music club or the dance club?
I signed up for both, but I mainly go to the dance club.
What style of dance does the dance club teach?
This semester we're mainly learning street dance. The instructor is hired from outside.
Is it friendly for complete beginners?
Very friendly. Everyone starts by learning the basic moves.
008: Why have you been glued to your computer lately?
I'm helping the programming club build a recruitment webpage.
You know how to make webpages? That's impressive.
It's actually not hard. There are lots of tutorials online you can learn from.
Then maybe I should go learn at the programming club too.
Come on over. We have free classes every Tuesday evening.
009: What book is your book club reading this week?
This week we're reading "To Live." The discussion is scheduled for Thursday.
I've read that book. It's really touching.
Yeah. You can come share your thoughts then.
Great. We'll meet on the third floor of the library at seven.
010: Junjie, did you go on the photography club's outing?
Yeah, we went to a park in the suburbs last week to take photos.
How did the photos turn out? Any shots you're happy with?
A few came out pretty well. I'm planning to enter them in the school exhibition.
You have to let me know when that happens.
No problem. I'll let you know the moment the exhibition starts.
